lines.beaver_en: Hello! Where is the recycling bin, by any chance?
lines.learner: 일 층 주차장 옆에 있어요. 같이 갈까요?
lines.en: It's next to the first-floor parking lot. Shall we go together?
lines.roman: Il cheung juchajang yeope isseoyo. Gachi galkkayo?

lines.beaver_en: Sure. I can just throw plastic away, right?
lines.learner: 아니요, 씻지 않으면 안 돼요. 라벨도 떼야 해요.
lines.en: No, you must wash it. You need to remove the label too.
lines.roman: Aniyo, ssitji aneumyeon an dwaeyo. Rabeldo ttaeya haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Oh, I see. I didn't know that.
lines.en: The management office tells us to wash it clean before throwing it out.

lines.beaver: 그런데 재활용을 하면 정말 도움이 돼요?
lines.beaver_roman: Geureonde jaehwaryongeul hamyeon jeongmal doumi dwaeyo?
lines.learner: 네, 환경 보호에 도움이 많이 될걸요.
lines.en: Yes, it probably helps protect the environment a lot.
lines.roman: Ne, hwangyeong bohoe doumi mani doelkkeollyo.

lines.beaver_en: I'm worried because there's so much trash these days.
lines.en: Right. The trash cans fill up every day.

lines.beaver_en: Oh, did you smell smoke last night?
lines.learner: 네, 누가 쓰레기를 태운 것 같아요.
lines.en: Yes, I think someone burned trash.
lines.roman: Ne, nuga sseuregireul taeun geot gatayo.

lines.beaver_en: We should report it if there's smoke, right?
lines.learner: 네, 불이 나면 위험하니까 신고하지 않으면 안 돼요.
lines.en: Yes, fire is dangerous, so we must report it.
lines.roman: Ne, buri namyeon wiheomhanikka singohaji aneumyeon an dwaeyo.

lines.beaver: 환경 문제에 대해 더 이야기해 볼래요?
lines.beaver_en: Shall we talk more about environmental issues?
lines.beaver_roman: Hwangyeong munjee daehae deo iyagihae bollaeyo?
lines.en: Sure. We should save electricity too.

lines.beaver: 우리 집은 전기 요금이 많이 나와요.
lines.beaver_en: Our electricity bill is really high.
lines.beaver_roman: Uri jibeun jeongi yogeumi mani nawayo.
lines.learner: 안 쓰는 플러그를 뽑으면 덜 나올걸요.
lines.en: If you unplug unused plugs, it'll probably be lower.
lines.roman: An sseuneun peulleogeureul ppobeumyeon deol naolkkeollyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good idea. I'll try it starting today.
lines.learner: 저도 아이들이 불을 끄게 할게요. 또 봐요!
lines.en: I'll make my kids turn off the lights too. See you!
lines.roman: Jeodo aideuri bureul kkeuge halkkeyo. Tto bwayo!
